translations.web: They have given the dead bodies of your servants to be food for the birds of the sky, the flesh of your saints to the animals of the earth.
translations.bsb: They have given the corpses of Your servants as food to the birds of the air, the flesh of Your saints to the beasts of the earth.
translations.kjv: The dead bodies of thy servants have they given to be meat unto the fowls of the heaven, the flesh of thy saints unto the beasts of the earth.
translations.asv: The dead bodies of thy servants have they given to be food unto the birds of the heavens, The flesh of thy saints unto the beasts of the earth.
